answer: Each identity files a unique artifact: a thread of task outputs. The thread ends in a summit proof of a job. The proof sits locked in a public vault. Auditors replay the thread; a copied thread or reused summit proof burns the 60-credit bond. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 threads at 60: 60,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A rented thread fails: the vault binds each thread to one key; a second filing burns both bonds. An honest agent files once, pays 60 once.
